About Tern's Exim

India's Trusted Merchant Export Partner

Tern's Exim is a merchant export company based in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu. Our primary business is sourcing, quality-checking, and exporting industrial fasteners, solar panel mounting systems, and a wide range of general trade goods to buyers across USA, Europe, UAE, and beyond.

Our fasteners conform to international standards including ISO 3506, ISO 898-1, DIN 931/933/934 and IEC 62548 — making import clearance smooth for buyers globally. All shipments dispatched FOB via Kochi Port with complete export documentation.

From SS304/SS316 stainless steel bolts and nuts to complete solar rooftop mounting kits, every product ships with material test reports, certificates of conformity and full commercial documentation.

Why Choose Tern's Exim?

Merchant Export Expertise

ISO & DIN Certified

ISO 3506, ISO 898-1, DIN 931/933/934, IEC 62548 and BIS certified products. Material test reports and CoC with every shipment.

Competitive Pricing

Kit composition, material grades (SS304/SS316/HDG), labelling and packaging customised to your exact project specifications.
